content:
marta: Ran a full nsys+perfetto pass on the 8xA100 pop run. Seeing a recurring ~8-12ms gap where matmul kernels finish but all-reduce doesn't start. nvtx shows compute streams idle then collective fanout. anyone seen compute->collective handoff stall like this? :thinking_face:
raj: Can you paste the nsys command and the small timeline excerpt? also nccl version and whether we're using p2p or ring fallback.
marta: nsys cmd: `nsys profile --trace=nvtx,cuda,nvtx-api --output=run2201`
perf-bot: Trace upload available: s3://redwood-traces/2201234567/run2201.qdrep
marta: snippet from perfetto summary (condensed):
```
[0.0s] GPU0: matmul_gemm fwd (stream 1)  ->  [0.015s]
[0.015s] GPU0: idle (stream 1)  ->  [0.023s]
[0.023s] GPU0: NCCL allreduce kickoff (stream 2) -> [0.035s]
[0.035s] GPU0: next matmul chunk (stream 1)
```
looks like collective is on a separate stream but delayed.
raj: what's NCCL_TRACE shows? maybe there's a rendezvous or retries causing delay. paste first few lines.
marta: nccl trace (condensed):
```
[rank0] Ring: init->connect
[rank0] Group start
[rank0] send/recv posted
[rank0] recv not-ready, retry
[rank0] fallback to ring-slow-path
```
oliver: interesting. if recv not-ready occurs we could be hitting a scheduling mismatch: kernel selector picks a heavy kernel on the same SMs, but our collective runs on a different stream and waits on host kick. check kernel-selector logs for `launch_policy=exclusive` or deferred launches.
sophie: also check KV cache evictions — if the cache eviction thread holds a pinned CPU lock, that can delay the host side post of the collective, causing the gap. i saw that once with the async-evictor.
jen: quick repro: try forcing `REDWOOD_BATCH_MODE=micro` or flip `REDWOOD_PREFIX_CACHE=false` to see if it moves the hotspot. if gap disappears it's likely KV rewarm owning the delay.
marta: repro runs:
- baseline: batch=64, prefix_cache=on -> median token latency 110ms, collective gap ~9-12ms
- forced micro batching (batch split 4) -> token latency 95ms, gap reduced to 5-6ms
- prefix_cache off -> token latency 92ms, collective gap 4ms
so disabling prefix caching reduced the gap but increased compute due to re-tokenization cost slightly.
raj: that suggests host-side work (cache/serializing) is pushing collective kickoff. two follow-ups: enable kernel debug logs and run with `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` and `NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS` to force system-level p2p to avoid unexpected fallback.
oliver: another option: move NCCL launches to dedicated comm stream and set stream priorities so collective can preempt smaller compute kernels. we already have a flag in runtime: `runtime.collective_stream_policy=dedicated` (default is `auto`). try forcing it.
marta: tried `runtime.collective_stream_policy=dedicated` + `NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS`. gap now ~3-4ms and token p95 dropped 18%. but we still see occasional spikes where allreduce stalls 10-12ms.
sophie: can you capture a full nvprof slice for one of the spikes and grep for `cudaEventRecord`/`cudaEventSynchronize` pairs — sometimes an accidental sync from a debugging path leaks into the hot loop.
marta: good call — found a leftover `cudaEventSynchronize` in the fallback path of the dispatcher during an error case. removing it fixed the rare spike in a local build.
jen: nice. next: run long-duration soak with `runtime.collective_stream_policy=dedicated`, `REDWOOD_PREFIX_CACHE=true` but with async-evictor bumped to higher interval (`EVICTOR_POLL_MS=5000`) to avoid frequent host interruptions. also run NCCL tests with `NCCL_TESTS=allreduce` to validate.
raj: i'll add a perf regression test: instrument gap histogram (compute->collective latency) and fail if p99 > 25ms. can you attach the perf-bot trace link to the PR?
marta: will do. thanks all :rocket:
content_summary: short thread about nsys/perfetto tracing of 8xA100 multi-gpu job, observed compute->collective gap, nccl trace showed recv-not-ready and fallback, root cause traced to host-side KV cache eviction and a stray cudaEventSynchronize; fixes and mitigations discussed: dedicated collective stream, NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS, toggling prefix cache, async evictor tuning, add regression test
